title: Modern Rescue segmented customization manifest
authorityLaw: Controls own public semantics, groups own closed recipe vocabularies, families own applicability edges, and the generated index owns rollups. No edge is hand-authored in two segments.
vocabularySourceLaw: applicableFamilyFields, internalChannelFields and controlDispositions are mirrors of customization-model/index.json#controlImpactContract. This file documents exactly what scripts/foundation/tokens/manifest/rules.mjs enforces; generator.test.mjs fails when the model, this schema and the generator's Sets disagree.

control.forbiddenLaw: Mirrors customization-model/index.json#controlImpactContract.forbiddenControlSegmentFields and scripts/foundation/tokens/manifest/rules.mjs#FORBIDDEN_CONTROL_FAMILY_EDGE_FIELDS. Checked RECURSIVELY: a top-level-only check let `representativeFamilyIds` and `mountClassIds` hide inside `calibration`.

vocabulary.domainKindsLaw: Lista CERRADA de domain.kind (decision delegada FAM-KINDS). Espejo exacto de scripts/foundation/tokens/manifest/rules.mjs DOMAIN_KINDS; index.mjs cobra ambos lados y el kind de cada control. Un kind fuera de la lista es defecto de manifiesto y pone el gate en rojo.

cellStateLadder.law: Requirements increase strictly. A weaker state never awards a stronger claim, and prose never substitutes for a resolvable binding, a receipt or a measured negative.
IMPLEMENTED: stableParts is a subset of anatomy.stableParts
propertyGroups is a subset of anatomy.propertyGroups
COMPUTED_VERIFIED: non-empty evidenceIds that resolve to content-validated receipts
at least one receipt with an evidenceProofRoles.COMPUTED_DELTA kind
at least one receipt with an evidenceProofRoles.EXACT_RESTORE kind
SIGHTED_ACCEPTED: at least one receipt with an evidenceProofRoles.SIGHTED kind whose producer is not the sighted approver

APPLICABLE: every applicableFamilyFields entry present and non-empty
staticSourceBindings and dbSourceBindings are separate and both resolve
dispositionLaw.negativeProofLaw: A path that merely exists is not a negative proof. The record must name the properties measured, the scope measured and the method used.

sectionLaw.maximumClaimCeiling: maximumClaim may never exceed maximumClaimByAssessmentState[strongest state reached by this family's cells and sections].

crossFileLaws: cardinalityLaw: a channel may have many productive consumers but never competing semantic owners
a channel retired anywhere may not still be LIVE or REQUIRED_ADDITION anywhere
a channel that is not RETIRED needs a producer and at least one productive consumer

reusesExistingContract: createdAt is not in the future
evidenceLaw.familyBinding: a receipt must name the claiming family or be program-scoped

testTruthLaw.isNotAKnownFailureList: This validates records lanes author. It never enumerates red tests, never becomes a repair queue and never duplicates work-order status.

sourceCorrespondenceLaw.sourceToInventory: every family-shaped directory under a canonical root must be claimed by exactly one row
familyShapedDirectory: under a canonical root derived from rows[].sourceRoot with nested roots collapsed
not internal to a claimed sourceOwner
its parent is the parent of at least one resolvedBy=folder-slug owner
exports at least one component-shaped symbol
does not import from its own parent barrel
declares an implementation of its own in at least one production index module
sourceCorrespondenceLaw.compatibilitySurfaceLaw: A directory whose production entrypoints only re-export somebody else's component preserves a historical import path and is not an independently implementable family, however complete its engines/, compound/, contracts/ and tests/ shape looks. Forwarding is not implementing, so a second real implementation under the same shape is still reported.
sourceCorrespondenceLaw.noAllowlist: Every clause is structural. A path allowlist would let a new family hide outside the declared inventory.

orthogonalityLaw.comparableSet: the APPLICABLE <familyId>::<propertyGroup> pairs of a control
orthogonalityLaw.escapeHatch: independentSemanticInvariant recorded on one of the two control manifests

progressLaw.acceptanceAuthority: Kimi K3 final sighted acceptance after the governed Fable 5 and Codex independent audits
